# HELP xet_hits_total Xorb range requests served from the local cache.
# TYPE xet_hits_total counter
xet_hits_total 12
# HELP xet_misses_total Xorb range requests that required an upstream fetch.
# TYPE xet_misses_total counter
xet_misses_total 4
# HELP xet_wan_bytes_total Bytes fetched from upstream (WAN).
# TYPE xet_wan_bytes_total counter
xet_wan_bytes_total 1.048576e+06
# HELP xet_peer_bytes_total Bytes pulled from peers (WAN/CDN transfer displaced).
# TYPE xet_peer_bytes_total counter
xet_peer_bytes_total 524288
# HELP xet_effective_hit_rate (hits + peer_hits) / (hits + misses): share of requests served without a CDN fetch.
# TYPE xet_effective_hit_rate gauge
xet_effective_hit_rate 0.75
# HELP xet_peer_throughput_bytes_per_ms Fleet-aggregate peer throughput EWMA (bytes/ms), used to size the hedge delay.
# TYPE xet_peer_throughput_bytes_per_ms gauge
xet_peer_throughput_bytes_per_ms 2.1
# HELP xet_peer_peer_throughput_bytes_per_ms Per-peer throughput EWMA (bytes/ms).
# TYPE xet_peer_peer_throughput_bytes_per_ms gauge
xet_peer_peer_throughput_bytes_per_ms{peer="http://a:8000"} 1.2
xet_peer_peer_throughput_bytes_per_ms{peer="http://b:8000"} 3.5
# HELP xet_xorb_latency_ms Served-range latency by source (hit|peer|cdn), milliseconds.
# TYPE xet_xorb_latency_ms histogram
xet_xorb_latency_ms_bucket{source="cdn",le="5"} 3
xet_xorb_latency_ms_bucket{source="cdn",le="25"} 7
xet_xorb_latency_ms_bucket{source="cdn",le="+Inf"} 8
xet_xorb_latency_ms_sum{source="cdn"} 96.5
xet_xorb_latency_ms_count{source="cdn"} 8
